messages:
anya: Need a compact webinar mini-kit for paid social + landing: social hero (3 CTA variants), webinar slide thumbnail (800x600), and a one-page benchmark summary PDF. Localize EN/DE. Drafts due Wed AM, final Tue EOD.
emma: Ack. Will do two layout families: stacked card and single-visual hero. Which CTAs?
anya: Watch webinar / Read benchmark / Request demo. Keep copy short for DE.
rafael: Imagery: abstract shapes only. I'll supply speaker headshots for the summary PDF.
emma: Export specs I'll use: social 1200x628 PNG, slide 800x600 PNG+PDF, summary PDF A4, fonts Inter 500/400. Filenames: yyyyMMdd_asset_variant_lang_v{n}.ext
design-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/webinar-mini-kit  editors: @emma @rafael
rafael: I'll assemble localization CSV (copy_id, EN, DE, alt_text). Emma, please add copy_id tokens in layers.
emma: Will do. QA checklist: logo clearspace, org-line on summary, contrast check, alt text for each language.
anya: Thanks — flag if timeline slips.
